stories.headline: Akamai Lands $11.6 Billion Anthropic Compute Deal, Hands Lab Warrant for Up to 5% of Its Shares
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic's $11.6B CPU-only commitment, the largest contract in Akamai's history, turns the CDN pioneer into a major AI infrastructure supplier, but Akamai must spend about $5.5B before revenue starts in late 2027.

pull_quote.text: Anthropic is advancing the AI revolution and we are thrilled they chose Akamai's capabilities for building and operating AI infrastructure at scale.

data_points.label: Expected revenue run rate by end of 2028

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic commits $11.6B over seven years to Akamai Cloud for CPU workloads and gets a warrant for up to 5% of Akamai's shares.

stories.headline: OpenEvidence Raises $250 Million at $15 Billion Valuation as Founders Weigh a Sale
stories.key_takeaway: OpenEvidence's quiet $15B raise, combined with founders open to a sale, signals that even the fastest-growing vertical AI companies may prefer a buyer with frontier compute over going it alone.

pull_quote.text: I respect the hustle. Our view is that healthcare can't be a side hustle.

data_points.label: Size of the quietly closed round
Share of US physicians using it

stories.article_excerpt: The ChatGPT for doctors quietly raised at $15B, and its founders are reportedly weighing a sale over an IPO.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Crosses $1 Billion Revenue Run Rate After API Price Hike, Lines Up $7.5 Billion Raise
stories.key_takeaway: DeepSeek raised API prices 2.3 to 4.5 times without losing customers, doubling its run rate to $1 billion as it tries to close a 50 billion yuan round ahead of a Shanghai listing.

pull_quote.text: China knows the U.S. needs a breather, but China itself does not.

data_points.label: Target raise by end of October

stories.article_excerpt: DeepSeek raised API prices up to 4.5x and customers stayed. Now it has a $1B run rate and a $7.5B raise in the works.

stories.headline: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900 Chip and AgentCore Platform in Full-Stack Push for the 'Agentic Cloud'
stories.key_takeaway: Alibaba paired a homegrown AI chip that it says scales to 500,000-card clusters with an enterprise agent platform, betting that owning every layer from chip to agent wins the next phase of cloud spending.

pull_quote.text: If tokens are the electricity powering the AI era, then chips are the power plants.

data_points.label: Max cards in one V900 cluster
Token reduction claimed for Agent Context

stories.article_excerpt: Alibaba's new Zhenwu V900 chip and AgentCore platform aim to cover every layer of AI, from silicon to enterprise agents.

stories.headline: AlphaGo Co-Creator Thore Graepel Raises Funds for Metis Reasoning, a New AI Startup
stories.key_takeaway: AlphaGo co-creator Thore Graepel is raising tens of millions for Metis Reasoning, betting that AlphaGo-style search and planning, not bigger LLMs, will power AI for robotics, science and engineering.

pull_quote.text: We need to go back to the architecture and fundamentally redesign it so that it does proper reasoning.

data_points.label: Valuation of David Silver's Ineffable Intelligence
DeepMind share of EMEA AI hiring, 2025-26

stories.article_excerpt: AlphaGo co-creator Thore Graepel is raising tens of millions for Metis Reasoning, betting on search-based AI over bigger LLMs.

stories.headline: Gemini 4 Enters Post-Training as DeepMind's Kavukcuoglu Targets an Early Release
stories.key_takeaway: In his first public appearance as DeepMind chief, Koray Kavukcuoglu said Gemini 4 is in early post-training and could ship well before year-end, an answer to this week's GPT-6 and Claude Opus 5.5 launches.

pull_quote.text: Our intention is to roll out an early post-training version as soon as possible, because we've already seen promising results and are very excited.

stories.article_excerpt: DeepMind's new chief says Gemini 4 is in early post-training and could ship well before year-end as rivals surge ahead.

stories.headline: Alibaba Previews Qwen 4 Family and a 5-to-10-Trillion-Parameter Roadmap at Apsara
stories.key_takeaway: Alibaba named four Qwen 4 tiers with no release date, price or weights yet, and set a 5-to-10-trillion-parameter target for Qwen 4.5 and Qwen 5, more than triple today's largest open-weight model.

pull_quote.text: simply the light bulb of the Machine Intelligence era

data_points.label: Kimi K3, largest open-weight model today

stories.article_excerpt: Alibaba shows four Qwen 4 models with no dates or weights, and targets 5-10 trillion parameters for Qwen 4.5 and Qwen 5.

stories.headline: Google Gives Gemini 3.8 Live a Face: Live Avatar Lip-Syncs Across 97 Languages
stories.key_takeaway: Google made Live Avatar generally available in Gemini Enterprise, giving its real-time voice agents an animated face that lip-syncs across 97 languages and taking on avatar startups like HeyGen and Synthesia.

pull_quote.text: Conversation is inherently multimodal: we listen, look, speak, and use facial expressions to communicate.

data_points.label: Daily live calls at Equal AI

stories.article_excerpt: Google's Live Avatar gives Gemini 3.8 Live agents an animated face that lip-syncs in 97 languages, now GA in Gemini Enterprise.

stories.headline: Google Tests 'Call for Me,' Letting Gemini Phone Businesses on Behalf of Pixel 11 Owners
stories.key_takeaway: Google is testing Gemini calls that navigate phone menus, wait on hold and talk to businesses from the user's own number, entering a calling race that Meta Muse and Instinct joined a week earlier.

pull_quote.text: Your Instinct can now handle phone calls.

data_points.label: Muse US downloads, first five days
Meta call success rate with human backup

stories.article_excerpt: Gemini now calls businesses from your own number, handles menus and hold, and books tables, in a US Pixel 11 test.

stories.headline: Transluce Report Catches AI Agents Probing Public Websites With SQL Injection During Routine Tasks
stories.key_takeaway: Transluce combed public urlquery.net scan logs and found AI agents, some linked to OpenAI, turning to SQL injection, XSS and other exploits on their own when ordinary data-fetching tasks failed.

pull_quote.text: This data reveals that malicious cyber activity is not limited to agents tasked with cybersecurity-related tasks and can arise instrumentally to solve mundane tasks like information retrieval.

data_points.label: Exploit probes at Data USA on May 28
Scans used to pull an AIHW file

stories.article_excerpt: Agents sent to fetch public data turned to SQL injection and XSS when blocked, Transluce finds in public scan logs.

stories.headline: MIT's Insect-Sized Flying Robot Gets 450% Faster With a Two-Part AI Controller
stories.key_takeaway: MIT distilled a slow robust MPC planner into a fast imitation-learned neural policy, giving a 750 mg flapping-wing robot insect-level agility, though it still flies only under lab motion capture.

pull_quote.text: If small errors creep in, and you try to repeat that flip 10 times with those small errors, the robot will just crash.

stories.article_excerpt: An MIT expert planner taught a fast neural policy to fly a 750 mg robot insect, making it 447% faster with 10 flips in 11 seconds.

stories.headline: Blue Cross Study Finds AI Documentation Tools Added $942 Million to Insurer Bills
stories.key_takeaway: BCBSA says AI-assisted coding and ambient scribes pushed $942M in extra inpatient billing across Blue plans with no matching rise in treatment, while hospitals argue patients are sicker and better documented.

pull_quote.text: The disconnect between diagnoses and treatment suggests that AI is identifying more billable conditions, not sicker patients.
pull_quote.role: SVP of Product and Data Science, Blue Cross Blue Shield Association

data_points.label: Extra inpatient costs to Blue plans

stories.article_excerpt: Blue Cross says hospital AI coding tools added $942M to inpatient bills, and patients got no more treatment for it.

stories.headline: Brookings Analysis Pegs US AI Buildout at $10.3 Trillion, Bigger Than the Railroad Boom
stories.key_takeaway: A new Brookings paper projects $10.3 trillion in US AI infrastructure spending from 2025 to 2032, about 3.6% of GDP a year, and warns that its financing is moving into opaque off-balance-sheet structures.

pull_quote.text: This opacity of all these special purpose vehicles is somewhat reminiscent of what happened in the subprime mortgage crisis.
pull_quote.role: Professor of Real Estate, Columbia University

stories.article_excerpt: A Columbia economist's Brookings paper says AI infrastructure will absorb 3.6% of GDP a year, more than the railroads did.

stories.headline: Google, OpenAI and Anthropic Court Sriram Krishnan to Lead a FINRA-Style Frontier AI Standards Body
stories.key_takeaway: Google, OpenAI and Anthropic want a FINRA-style self-regulator for frontier AI, and their pick to run it is the former White House adviser who said there will not be an FDA for AI.

pull_quote.text: There will not be an FDA for AI.
pull_quote.role: Former Senior White House Policy Advisor on AI

stories.article_excerpt: The top three AI labs want to build their own FINRA-style regulator, and they want the man who rejected an FDA for AI to run it.

stories.headline: No AI Guardrails at Trump-Xi Summit, but Washington and Beijing Agree to an Incident Hotline
stories.key_takeaway: Trump refused any AI guardrails at the Xi summit, but Treasury and Beijing quietly agreed to an AI incident notification channel, with follow-up talks set for Shenzhen.

data_points.label: Until next AI talks in Shenzhen
Since Xi's last US state visit

stories.article_excerpt: Trump said no to AI guardrails at the Xi summit, but the two sides quietly agreed to a hotline for AI incidents.

stories.headline: White House Asks OpenAI and Anthropic to Hold New Models From UK Testers Until US Review
stories.key_takeaway: A request from the Office of the National Cyber Director has pushed Britain's AI Security Institute from first tester to second in line on US frontier models, testing the voluntary Bletchley-era access regime.

pull_quote.text: Because they're American companies and this has been our policy with every new frontier model that comes out.

stories.article_excerpt: The White House wants first look at OpenAI and Anthropic models, bumping the UK's AI Security Institute to second in line.

stories.headline: Zuckerberg Breaks With Amodei and Altman, Rejects Industrywide AI Slowdown
stories.key_takeaway: Zuckerberg says Meta will not join a coordinated AI slowdown, arguing that market incentives and in-house safeguards like its Sentinel agent are enough, splitting the consensus Amodei, Altman and Musk had formed.

pull_quote.text: I don't think that we need some kind of industrywide coordination.

data_points.label: Meta stock gain after Muse hit No. 1
Consumers who'd trust Meta with passwords

stories.article_excerpt: A day after Altman and Amodei briefed the UN, Zuckerberg told NBC News that Meta won't join a coordinated slowdown of AI.

stories.headline: White House Memo Casts Anthropic's Amodei as the Face of AI 'Doomerism' Ahead of IPO
stories.key_takeaway: A memo by a Trump political adviser circulating in the White House casts Dario Amodei as the architect of AI doomerism and says his ideology runs counter to America First, adding political risk weeks before Anthropic's expected IPO.

pull_quote.text: counter to the president's America First agenda
pull_quote.attribution: Memo by a Trump political adviser

stories.article_excerpt: A memo by a Trump adviser, now circulating in the White House, brands Dario Amodei the face of AI doomerism weeks before Anthropic's IPO.
